notes.title: Content Creators Update
notes.notes:
Hi Warchasm players,

The latest patch (V1.25) has just gone live and features some major updates.

First off and most importantly Warchasm now supports mixed reality streaming for the LIV community. Thanks to the awesome team over at LIV.TV Warchasm now features full support for the LIV SDK so streamers, content creators and players can now broadcast in mixed reality!

While the feature has been in Beta for a while now the latest patch brings mixed reality to the core game. As such, people currently testing this feature on the beta branch are advised to now move over to the standard game.

[h3]About the soundtrack[/h3]
The Warchasm soundtrack has been produced entirely in house and is unique to the Warchasm VR experience. As such there should be no little red flags going up from youtube etc.

[h2]Full patch notes[/h2]

[h3]Broadcasting[/h3]
[list]
[*] LIV Integration.
[*] Game no longer drops sound when window loses focus.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Levels now unlock with less stars.
[*] Threshold for scoring a perfect 3 stars is lower.
[*] Cool down on specials is shorter.
[*] Shield regeneration is faster.
[*] Primary weapons are now better aligned with VR controllers.
[*] Players take less damage on normal and easy difficulty.
[*] Less mobs spawn in Easy mode.
[*] Spin reload now awards players 10 rounds instead of 5.
[*] Specials now unlock simultaneously at end of the Canyon level.
[/list]

[h3]Other Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed a bug sometimes preventing players from unlocking final stages of the Nexus.
[*] Fixed missing geometry around doors in Ruins level.
[*] Cart is now easier to tilt over track fires.
[/list]

That's everything for now though there are more exciting updates in the works that will be announced soon.

Best regards,

Dave

notes.title: New Patch Released
notes.notes:
Good morning Warchasm Fans!

I hope you are all well and looking forward to the weekend. Just wanted to give you a quick heads up on todays patch which addresses a number of smaller issues.

Namely...
[list]
[*] Fixes a bug where the menu pointer would sometimes disappear.
[*] Fixes an issue where a drone would randomly spawn and explode in front of you.
[*] Fixes an issue where a random crashing sound would play occasionally in the Canyon stages
[*] Fixes an issue where wrecking balls were spawning in a cluster *only affected stage 3 of the canyons when played in hard mode.
[/list]

[b]Note for Oculus Quest players.[/b]

If you are playing Warchasm on Quest via Virtual Desktop make sure that you are launching the game through Steam. I have had reports that while the game can be launched outside of Steam you may not get sound and keeping things inside Steam will fix this.

That's everything for today. Please stay tuned though as I do have some big announcements coming up regarding the Warchasm roadmap outlining where I am taking the games development over the coming months.

This new build is live now so should update automatically when you first login to Steam.

Best regards and thank you for playing my game.

Dave
